name: neuroschema.org
description: A curated, automatically evaluated catalog of neuroscience ontologies, schemas, vocabularies and data standards.

sister.name: SchemaScope
sister.title: Looking for another domain?
sister.blurb: NeuroSchema covers neuroscience. For ontologies and schemas in every other field, from life sciences, chemistry and earth science to engineering, privacy, law and computing, use our sister catalog SchemaScope. It is scored with the same rubric.

about: Neuroscience data is described with dozens of ontologies, controlled vocabularies, metadata schemas and data standards, maintained by different communities and registries. NeuroSchema brings them into one catalog, organised by domain, so you can see what exists, which version is current, how FAIR and well maintained it is, and who already uses it.
